Title: Anarch tri-discipline "More that one Discipline may be used to play this card"

Messages.Author: jvamp
Messages.Body:
I would like an official ruling on Anarch Tri-disciplines cards such as The Platinum Protocol that state "More that one Discipline may be used to play this card".

I have been told that this allows you to use ALL the effects on the card if you meet the requirements. For example The Platinum Protocol is a D Bleed at +1 stealth AND +1 bleed AND placing 1 corruption counter (assuming you are Anarch with the right discs).

Can someone confirm whether these cards allow you to use ALL the effects AT THE SAME TIME, or whether the meaning is instead to CHOOSE ONLY ONE?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> jvamp wrote:
> I would like an official ruling on Anarch Tri-disciplines cards such as The Platinum Protocol that state "More that one Discipline may be used to play this card".
>
Yes. It means that you can choose the skill Presence, Obfuscate, and Protean. Or two of those. Or only one (but not zero).

> jvamp wrote:
> I have been told that this allows you to use ALL the effects on the card if you meet the requirements. For example The Platinum Protocol is a D Bleed at +1 stealth AND +1 bleed AND placing 1 corruption counter (assuming you are Anarch with the right discs).
>
Correct.

> jvamp wrote:
> Can someone confirm whether these cards allow you to use ALL the effects AT THE SAME TIME, or whether the meaning is instead to CHOOSE ONLY ONE?
>
Choosing only one Discipline is the default rule for playing cards requiring a Discipline. The extra text on Platinum Protocol allows you to choose additional Disciplines.
